en.title: Qwen3-14B: a dense 14.8B model with grouped-query attention
en.body:
Qwen3-14B has 14.8B parameters in 40 layers. Its 40 query heads share 8 key-value heads, so its KV cache is 5x smaller than full multi-head attention would need.

The card below shows what it takes to run at common precisions, computed from its config.json.

tr.title: Qwen3-14B: grouped-query attention kullanan 14,8B'lik yoğun model
tr.body:
Qwen3-14B, 40 katmanda 14,8B parametreye sahip. 40 query head 8 key-value head'i paylaşıyor; bu yüzden KV cache'i tam multi-head attention'a göre 5 kat küçük.

Aşağıdaki kart, config.json'dan hesaplanarak, yaygın hassasiyetlerde ne gerektiğini gösteriyor.
